title: Cap. IV Arg. 5 Sol cont: faith may accompany temporal adoption — not eternal destinatio; chain from election
pass_a_gloss: Let faith precede, or at least accompany, adoption perfected in the elect themselves: but it cannot (even according to our mode of considering) precede the adoption decreed and destined in the mind of God electing from eternity for certain persons. For efficacious vocation, or according to purpose, precedes saving faith; predestination or election to glory precedes such vocation: whence it is clear that none are considered or foreseen as faithful except from the antecedent decree of predestination, because efficacious vocation, true faith, and real adoption flow thence.
pass_b_english: Faith may precede or at least go with adoption finished in the elect themselves — but it cannot (even on our way of thinking) precede the adoption God from eternity decreed and destined for certain persons in his electing mind. Efficacious vocation according to purpose precedes saving faith; predestination or election to glory precedes that vocation. So none are considered or foreseen as faithful except from the antecedent predestination decree — because efficacious vocation, true faith, and real adoption flow from it.
source_text: Praecedat fides, aut comitetur saltem adoptionem in ipsis electis peractam: at non potest (vel secundum nostrum considerandi modum) praecedere adoptionem in mente Dei eligentis ab aeterno certis personis decretam et destinatam. Nam fidem salutiferam praecedit vocatio efficax, vel secundum propositum; talem vocationem antecedit praedestinatio sive electio ad gloriam: unde clarum est, non considerari ullos aut praevideri tanquam fideles nisi ex antecedente praedestinationis decreto, quia efficax vocatio, vera fides, et realis adoptio inde dimanat.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. IV Arg. 5 Sol rem. + Arg. 6 section 378. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap4_arg6_densify. Honest partial.
